description: Read-only GETs of a REST API of your own (a status page, an internal service), restricted to the path prefixes you list. Off until an environment sets it up.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the API, e.g. https://api.internal.example.com/v1

allow.description: Comma-separated path prefixes the assistant may read, e.g. /orders,/health. Nothing else is reachable.

token.description: A read-only token, if the API needs one

tokenHeader.description: Header carrying the token: 'authorization' sends 'Bearer <token>', any other name sends the token as is (e.g. x-api-key)

get.description: GET one path of the team's REST API and return what it answers (one record per item of a list). Read-only: only paths under the configured prefixes can be read.

path.description: Path under the base URL, starting with /, e.g. /orders/4512

query.description: Query string without the ?, e.g. status=stuck&limit=20
